### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Start Mouser on Computer A with...
2. Pair with Computer B...
3. Move cursor to...
4. See error.

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Environment & System Info
- **Mouser Version:** (e.g. 0.9.0 or commit hash)
- **Operating System:** Windows 10 / Windows 11 / Linux
- **Network Environment:** Wired Ethernet / Wi-Fi / VPN (Tailscale)

### Logs & Diagnostics
If applicable, navigate to the **Activity** tab in Mouser, click **Copy Diagnostics**, or attach relevant excerpts from `%APPDATA%\Mouser\logs\`.
*(Note: Mouser automatically sanitizes pairing keys and clipboard text from crash reports, but please double-check that no private data is included before submitting.)*
